name: Remesh Modifier
description: Generate a new surface with regular topology that follows the shape of the input mesh

items.name: Blocks
items.description: Output a blocky surface with no smoothing

items.name: Smooth
items.description: Output a smooth surface with no sharp-features detection

items.name: Sharp
items.description: Output a surface that reproduces sharp edges and corners from the input mesh

items.name: Voxel
items.description: Output a mesh corresponding to the volume of the original mesh

props.name: Scale
props.description: The ratio of the largest dimension of the model over the size of the grid

props.name: Threshold
props.description: If removing disconnected pieces, minimum size of components to preserve as a ratio of the number of polygons in the largest component

props.name: Octree Depth
props.description: Resolution of the octree; higher values give finer details

props.name: Sharpness
props.description: Tolerance for outliers; lower values filter noise while higher values will reproduce edges closer to the input

props.name: Voxel Size
props.description: Size of the voxel in object space used for volume evaluation. Lower values preserve finer details.

props.name: Adaptivity
props.description: Reduces the final face count by simplifying geometry where detail is not needed, generating triangles. A value greater than 0 disables Fix Poles.

props.name: Smooth Shading
props.description: Output faces with smooth shading rather than flat shaded
